collaborations.name: Newark Water Coalition
collaborations.description: Two years volunteering with a grassroots organization focused on water access, infrastructure equity, and environmental justice. Work includes: field surveys, community education, policy briefs, and supporting residents through structural failure points.
impact: Documented 100+ households facing water-related infrastructure failures
Facilitated 15+ community meetings on water rights and access
Co-authored reports on Newark's water system vulnerabilities
Supported emergency response during service disruptions
collaborations.keyLearning: Structural failures aren't abstract — they're in my backyard. Healing requires individuals to first heal themselves.

collaborations.name: Newark Community Media Projects
collaborations.description: Creating audio and visual documentation of Newark communities, focusing on lived experience, resistance, and the work of local organizing. Projects include street photography, ambient sound studies, and community archiving.
impact: Published audio/visual essays on Newark street life
Built archive of local organizing voices
collaborations.keyLearning: The work of communities to sustain themselves is its own form of evidence.
